title: TOEIC RC 실전 평가 (단일 지문 집중)

questions.question: The chief financial officer noted that the projected revenue surplus is largely _______ the unprecedented surge in overseas subscriptions.
questions.explanation: 문맥상 예상 수익 흑자가 해외 구독의 전례 없는 급증에 '기인한다(덕분이다)'는 인과관계를 나타내야 하므로, '~에 기인하는'의 뜻을 가진 형용사구 (C) attributable to가 정답입니다.
optionExplanations: adjacent to: ~에 인접한 (위치 관계를 나타내므로 부적절)

questions.question: Only after conducting a rigorous audit of the supply chain _______ the executive board approve the multi-million-dollar acquisition.
questions.explanation: 'Only + 부사구/부사절'이 문두에 올 경우 주어와 동사가 도치됩니다. 본동사 approve가 일반동사 원형이므로 과거 시제 도치를 이끄는 조동사 (A) did가 주어(the executive board) 앞에 와야 합니다.
optionExplanations: did: 일반동사 과거형 도치를 완성하는 조동사 (정답)
would have: 과거분사가 뒤따라야 하므로 동사원형 approve와 결합 불가
was: 수동태나 진행형을 만들어야 하므로 동사원형과 결합 불가
having: 준동사이므로 정형동사 도치 구문을 완성할 수 없음

questions.question: To maintain its competitive edge in biomedical research, NexaCorp will _______ recruit top-tier clinical investigators from leading universities.
questions.explanation: 생명공학 연구 분야에서 경쟁력을 유지하기 위해 정상급 임상 연구원들을 '적극적으로/공격적으로' 채용한다는 의미가 자연스러우므로 동사 recruit를 수식하는 부사 (D) aggressively가 정답입니다.

questions.question: _______ the sudden fluctuation in raw material prices, the logistics team managed to deliver all orders within the stipulated timeframe.
questions.explanation: 빈칸 뒤에 명사구(the sudden fluctuation in raw material prices)가 오고, 전체 문장이 역접의 의미를 지니고 있으므로 명사구를 이끄는 양보 전치사 (B) Notwithstanding(~에도 불구하고)이 정답입니다.
optionExplanations: Even if: 접속사로 뒤에 주어+동사 절이 필요함

questions.question: The contract stipulations specify that compensation will be _______ with each candidate’s years of managerial experience.
questions.explanation: 전치사 with와 결합하여 '각 후보자의 관리직 경력 연수에 비례하여/상응하여 보상이 제공된다'는 의미를 완성하는 형용사 (C) commensurate가 정답입니다. (be commensurate with: ~에 상응하다/비례하다)

questions.question: [1]번 빈칸 선택
questions.explanation: 문맥상 새로운 자동 검사 시스템을 공장에 공식적으로 '도입하다/실행하다'라는 의미가 와야 하므로 (B) implement가 정답입니다.
questions.scenario:
```
[Internal Memorandum]

MEMORANDUM
To: All Engineering and Production Staff
From: Valerie Sterling, Director of Quality Assurance
Date: September 8, 2026
Subject: Transition to Automated Inspection Protocols

Over the past two quarters, AeroTech Dynamics has been evaluating ways to optimize assembly line efficiency while minimizing hardware defects. Following an extensive internal assessment, we will formally [1] the Helios Automated Inspection System across all manufacturing facilities beginning next month.

This transition will require temporary adjustments to our standard workflow. During the initial rollout, technician shifts will be slightly modified to accommodate comprehensive training workshops. Please be assured that these sessions are designed to [2] seamless adaptation rather than add to your daily workload. [3] Senior specialists will also be on-site around the clock to offer immediate guidance.

The system upgrade represents a critical milestone in our strategic roadmap. We greatly appreciate your patience and [4] dedication as we strive to set a new benchmark for manufacturing excellence.
```

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the press release?
options: To announce a fleet modernization partnership
To advertise new driving employment opportunities
To report on severe financial losses in freight
To review consumer feedback on electric vehicles
questions.explanation: 지문 전체는 Greendale Logistics가 GreenGrid Energy와의 파트너십을 통해 화물 트럭을 전기 및 반자율주행 차량으로 전환하는 차량 현대화 사업을 발표하고 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다.
optionExplanations: To announce a fleet modernization partnership: 차량 현대화 파트너십 발표 (정답)
To advertise new driving employment...: 신규 운전직 채용 광고가 아님
To report on severe financial losses...: 재정 손실 보고가 아님
To review consumer feedback...: 소비자 피드백 검토가 아님
questions.scenario:
```
[Document 1: Press Release]

PORTLAND (September 8) — Greendale Logistics, one of the Pacific Northwest's prominent freight carriers, announced today a multi-year partnership with GreenGrid Energy to convert its regional delivery fleet to fully electric, semi-autonomous trucks. The joint initiative, valued at approximately $45 million, aims to reduce the company's carbon footprint by 40 percent over the next four years while significantly cutting long-haul fuel expenses.

Under the terms of the agreement, GreenGrid Energy will install 60 high-capacity charging terminals at Greendale’s primary distribution hubs in Seattle, Portland, and Boise. In addition, GreenGrid will supply specialized battery-monitoring software that optimizes charging schedules during off-peak utility hours. This strategic integration is anticipated to shield the carrier from volatile energy prices.

Greendale’s chief executive officer, Marcus Vance, emphasized that the deployment of semi-autonomous vehicles will not result in workforce reductions. Instead, current drivers will undergo comprehensive retraining to operate as fleet navigators and safety supervisors. The initial batch of 50 electric freight carriers is slated for delivery early next spring, with full operational deployment expected by the end of 2027. Preliminary road trials conducted earlier this summer demonstrated a 28 percent improvement in transit reliability under severe weather conditions.
```

questions.question: What is stated about Greendale Logistics' current drivers?
options: They will be relocated to the Boise hub.
They will receive training for new supervisory roles.
They must purchase their own navigation software.
They will face immediate layoffs next spring.
questions.explanation: 3단락에서 인력 감축(workforce reductions)은 없을 것이며, 기존 운전자들이 'fleet navigators and safety supervisors(차량 운항사 및 안전 감독관)'로 근무할 수 있도록 포괄적 재교육을 받을 것이라고 언급되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다.
optionExplanations: They will be relocated...: 보이시 허브로 이전된다는 내용은 없음
They will receive training...: 새로운 감독 역할에 대한 교육을 받는다는 내용과 일치 (정답)
They must purchase...: 자체 소프트웨어를 구매해야 한다는 언급 없음
They will face immediate layoffs...: 인력 감축은 없다고 명시되어 일치하지 않음
